#2198. Che fine ha fatto Hysaj? Retroscena di mercato e futuro ancora in bilico

Sfumate le piste in Serie A per ingaggio e scelte dei club: l'albanese aspetta un'offerta dall'Europa

Tra i giocatori biancocelesti finiti svincolati al termine della passata stagione c’è anche Elseid Hysaj. Secondo quanto riportato da TUTTOmercatoWEB, il terzino albanese, dopo l'esperienza nella Capitale, non è ancora riuscito a trovare una sistemazione, pur rimanendo un punto fermo della propria Nazionale. Attualmente l'ex difensore della Lazio si mantiene in forma allenandosi presso il centro sportivo di Monteboro insieme alla Primavera dell'Empoli.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

L'esterno trentaduenne ha avuto diverse opportunità per rimanere nel massimo campionato italiano, ma nessuna trattativa è andata a buon fine. A fine mercato estivo ci ha provato concretamente il Lecce, rinunciando poi all'affare a causa delle pretese d'ingaggio del calciatore, non in linea con i parametri della società salentina. Successivamente è stato il Bologna a valutare l'albanese per rimpiazzare l'infortunato Holm, ma i rossoblù hanno infine preferito virare su Darmian una volta superati i dubbi di natura fisica su quest'ultimo.

Di recente sono arrivate manifestazioni d'interesse anche dagli Emirati Arabi, ma la destinazione mediorientale non rappresenta al momento la priorità di Hysaj, che punta a rimanere nel calcio europeo. Nell'attesa che si presenti l'occasione giusta per firmare un nuovo contratto, il difensore prosegue il suo lavoro sul campo per farsi trovare pronto alla chiamata.

#2197. Guerrero incoraggia la Juve Women: "In Champions vogliamo competere, ma ora testa all'Inter"

"Abbiamo affrontato una delle due o tre squadre più forti al mondo, una formazione che può vincere questa competizione. Credo che fino al primo gol abbiamo fatto una buona partita, mantenendo ordine ed equilibrio, poi dopo il gol abbiamo iniziato a soffrire maggiormente. Anche nella ripresa abbiamo avuto alcuni momenti positivi, ma contro avversarie di questo livello ogni situazione diventa complicata": forse qualche attenuante di troppo, quella che trova Isaac Guerrero nel commentare la disfatta della sua Juventus Women in Champions. Sì, il Lione è una delle formazioni più forti al mondo, ma un ko casalingo sul punteggio di 0-6 è forse troppo.

Come si legge sui canali ufficiali del club, il trainer aggiunge poi: "Abbiamo una squadra molto giovane e le ragazze hanno dato tutto: queste partite rappresentano un'occasione importante per crescere e imparare. Dobbiamo continuare a lavorare sulla nostra identità e sul nostro modo di giocare, come abbiamo fatto nelle altre gare europee. Vogliamo continuare a competere, consapevoli che dobbiamo ancora migliorare molto".

Nota conclusiva, al campionato. Domenica ci sarà l'Inter, seconda forza della classifica di Serie A Women: "Adesso dobbiamo concentrarci sulla partita di domenica, che sarà molto importante, e poi sulla prossima sfida europea contro il Leuven".

#2195. Scuole, allarme bomba da Roma alla Toscana: alunni portati fuori

Ad Arezzo i bambini della Tricca sono stati accompagnati al parco Pertini in attesa dei genitori.

Un allarme bomba via email ha raggiunto centinaia di scuole italiane l’11 novembre 2026. Secondo quanto riportato da Corriere, Negli istituti che hanno ricevuto la segnalazione anonima, dirigenti e personale stanno facendo uscire gli studenti in via precauzionale, per consentire le verifiche. Gli avvisi riguardano anche Roma, Frosinone e Rieti, oltre a città e province da Nord a Sud.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Nel messaggio si legge: «Ho appena lasciato nel vostro edificio, all'interno di un sacchetto di plastica, un potente ordigno esplosivo con innesco a distanza». La mail è firmata da Mikhail Andropov, che si presenta come «leader del Vilajat del Misoginistan». Si tratta del contenuto della minaccia, non di una presenza di esplosivi accertata.

Una comunicazione di allarme bomba è stata inviata via email a tutte le scuole di Roma. La polizia, contattata dagli istituti, ha indicato di liberare gli edifici con calma. Gli studenti sono tornati nelle proprie abitazioni.

Tra le province in cui risultano segnalazioni figurano anche Frosinone e Rieti. Fuori dal Lazio, gli avvisi sono stati registrati nelle province di Venezia, Trieste, Padova e Brescia, oltre che a Potenza; altre province si stanno aggiungendo all’elenco. Secondo quanto riferisce Corriere, la matrice comune delle email alimenta il sospetto che la minaccia possa essere collegata a un nuovo attacco informatico contro le istituzioni italiane. Nei giorni precedenti circa 200 presidi di scuole di ogni ordine e grado avevano già ricevuto una segnalazione simile.

In Toscana le email minatorie hanno portato a evacuazioni in più province. Tra Firenze e il suo territorio sarebbero cinque gli istituti coinvolti. Altri avvisi riguardano la provincia di Arezzo, con scuole di ogni ordine e grado, dall’infanzia alle superiori, e le province di Siena e Pisa.

Ad Arezzo città i bambini della scuola elementare Tricca sono stati accompagnati al parco Pertini in attesa dei genitori. Sono state evacuate anche la primaria di Staggiano e la scuola materna di Matrignano. Nel Casentino hanno lasciato gli edifici il liceo scientifico Galilei di Poppi e l’Itis Fermi di Bibbiena.

In Versilia, il Comune di Seravezza ha scritto su Facebook: «Una email, arrivata all'Istituto comprensivo, ha annunciato la presenza di un ordigno alla scuola primaria Frediani. Scattate quindi le procedure di evacuazione che hanno interessato sia gli alunni della scuola sia i dipendenti del Municipio».

A Modena è in corso l’evacuazione di almeno cinque istituti superiori e di una scuola primaria. La stessa misura interessa altri due istituti superiori a Vignola e Sassuolo. La polizia locale presidia le scuole coinvolte per garantire la viabilità.

#2194. ‘Bigger teams will come good’: EFL expert sends Birmingham City promotion warning amid stunning Championship form

Birmingham City are top of the table after their first 15 fixtures of the season. BCFC are above Middlesbrough and Stoke City on goal difference following their 2-1 win over Swansea City last time out before the international break.

Attacker Jay Stansfield scored both of the Blues’ goals against the Swans last Saturday. They are back in action with an away trip to Stoke City next weekend.

In the meantime, McAnuff, who played for the likes of Cardiff City, Watford and Reading, has delivered his honest verdict on the Midlands outfit on the latest epiode of BBC’s 72+ Podcast: “Under his (Tom Wagner) guidance, after everything he has put into the club, there is no reason why with such an open start to the league, this could be the season particularly going down to eight teams this year, where they can’t at least get (into the play-offs).

“I’m sure they’ll have designs on finishing higher. I do think some of the bigger teams will come good later on in the season.”

Birmingham City re-signed James Beadle on loan from Brighton and Hove Albion in the summer. BCFC’s goalkeeper is a year older now and is backed up on the bench by Ryan Allsop.

The Blues are rock solid at the back and have the best defensive record in the division just ahead of West brom and Southampton. They have Christoph Klarer and Phil Neumann to thank for that and the pair have both been excellent.

Further up the pitch, the likes of Paik Seung-ho, Tomoki Iwata and Jhon Solis are useful players in the middle of the park. They are energetic and can create chances for their attacking.

Stansfield, Liam Millar, Patrick Roberts, Carlos Vicente and August Priske are all dangerous forward places for Birmingham City. They can cause serious problems to opposition defenders and Chris Davies’ side are good on the break.

Birmingham City are looking strong at the moment and will be in confident mood. BCFC don’t concede many goals and are built on strong foundations.

The Blues will get the chance to bring in some new faces when the January transfer window opens up for business. They will also have the opportunity to let some players head out the exit door as well if needed this winter to help free up space and funds to pave the way for reinforcements.

Davies’ men were promoted from League One in 2025 along with Wrexham and Charlton Athletic and they finished 10th last term as they adapted to the step up a division. They have really found their feet this season and will fancy their chances against anyone right now as they gear up for a tricky trip to Stoke City next up.

#2193. Calciomercato Napoli, Manna: “Varela è un buon giocatore, ma difficile che il Monza lo venda. Cacciamani? Il panorama italiano è ricco”

Giovanni Manna ha rilasciato una lunga intervista a Radio Kiss Kiss Napoli. Ecco solo la parte sul mercato:

“Mercato? Con il mister e il presidente ci confrontiamo ogni giorno. In questo momento, qualche precauzione la troviamo sempre. Abbiamo le idee chiare, cercheremo di migliorare la rosa. Dobbiamo però arrivarci a gennaio: ci sono tante partite. Dobbiamo dare continuità di risultati. Lo scorso anno abbiamo speso tanto, forse dovevamo spendere meglio, lo dico anche facendo autocritica. Col presidente non ci siamo mai tirati indietro. Abbiamo dovuto rispettare dei parametri. Nessuno ci ha vietato di vendere o comprare, semplicemente non ci siamo riusciti. A gennaio ci faremo trovare pronti. Le idee chiare le avevamo anche prima, nell’anno post scudetto abbiamo anche fatto 12-13 acquisti. Poi, è chiaro, c’è sempre qualcuno che esplode e chi meno. Cacciamani? Spesso si spendono cifre folli per chi non ha ancora dimostrato nulla. Dobbiamo stare attenti. Stiamo seguendo diversi giocatori. Il panorama italiano è ricco, ci sono giocatori interessanti, vogliamo dare loro opportunità. Guardiamo a tutti i campionati. Spesso escono diversi nomi, alcuni fuorvianti. Che giochi in Spagna, Francia o Inghilterra, l’innesto che ci servirà deve dare una mano. Ripeto, però: dobbiamo prima arrivare a gennaio! Varela? E’ un buon giocatore, ma attualmente abbiamo Hojlund, Lucca e Giovane che può essere impiegato nel ruolo di centravanti. Il portoghese sta performando, è difficile che il Monza si privi di un giocatore così. Se lo dovesse fare, non lo regalerà di certo. Il Napoli, in questo momento, non ha fatto alcun passo con nessuno”.

#2192. Joao Pedro double and Caicedo stunner give Chelsea win over AC Milan

Chelsea cruised to victory over Ruben Amorim’s AC Milan in Jakarta, Indonesia, on Saturday. Goals from Moises Caicedo and a double from João Pedro either side of half-time led Xabi Alonso’s side to their second win on their Far East tour.

The game was fairly even in the first half and looked set to head into the break level at 0-0 but Pedro’s header from Moises Caicedo’s corner put Chelsea in front.

The west London side then doubled their advantage seconds into the second half as Pedro scored his second, assisted by Pedro Neto.

Just minutes later, Chelsea had their third courtesy of a well-worked corner routine. Romeo Lavia’s delivery was met by Caicedo on the volley, with the Ecuadorian’s finish with the outside of the boot finding the bottom corner.

MOISÉS CAICEDO THAT IS INCREDIBLE 🤯 pic.twitter.com/C6CEcUG1sE

Chelsea had further chances to extend their lead in a dominant second-half performance but were unable to add to their three goals.

Chelsea conclude their tour of the Far East with a game against Johor Darul Ta’zim on Sunday in Malaysia before returning home.

Their final pre-season game will be against Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge before beginning their Premier League campaign at Fulham.

AC Milan take on Amorim’s former club Manchester United next Saturday before they kick off their Serie A campaign at Torino on August 23.

Chelsea managed to lure Austin MacPhee to take care of their set-pieces and today Chelsea scored two goals from corners. Here is a snippet of Mike McGrath’s piece on MacPhee’s arrival at Chelsea:

He is among the new breed of coaches who are rock stars in their own right, taking centre-stage since rules were changed so that only one person is allowed in the technical area at a time. For MacPhee to get closer to the players for a set-piece, it will mean Xabi Alonso taking a step back onto the bench.

It has been an incredible rise for MacPhee, 46, who was working on Michael O’Neill’s staff with Northern Ireland 10 years ago this summer, helping them reach the knockout stages of the European Championship.

Chelsea take on Johor Darul Ta’zim in Malaysia tomorrow before returning to the UK. Their final pre-season game will be against Real Sociedad before taking on Fulham on the opening weekend of the new season.

AC Milan will play Manchester United next weekend and then kick off their Serie A campaign against Torino.

Possession: Chelsea 50%-50% AC MilanShots: 18-5Shots on target: 8-0Corners: 7-2

The final whistle is blown in Jakarta and Chelsea have cruised to a 3-0 win over AC Milan. Goals from Caicedo and a double from Pedro either side of half-time have led Xabi Alonso’s side to the victory. They have one more game out in the Far East before returning home to the UK.

What a performance! 👏 pic.twitter.com/GcUZXwXbRj

Ramos is picked out after making a run into the Chelsea box and is denied by Sanchez. However, the offside flag has gone up anyway against Ramos. AC Milan have barely threatened the Chelsea goal in this second half.

A late change for Chelsea as Sarr replaces Fofana.

Chelsea are seeking their fourth goal as Quenda strikes a shot powerfully from just outside the box but it goes narrowly wide. Xabi Alonso’s side have dominated this second half.

Estevao has the chance to score moments after coming on after good work from the Brazilian down Chelsea’s right but is denied by a good save from Torriani.

Chelsea make a triple changes as Estevao, Mudryk and Watson come on. Mudryk made his return after his doping ban against Juventus during the week.

Chelsea hit the frame of the goal once more. Jackson gets the better of Vladimirov down Chelsea’s left and moves into the AC Milan penalty area. Jackson opens up his body as if he is going to curl his shot into the far corner but instead shoots towards the near corner, with his effort coming off the post.

Ricci goes for an audacious strike with the outside of his right foot from outside the box but his effort misses the target.

Palmer was deep in conversation with his boss Alonso during that water break.

Chelsea made a substitution during that break as Anselmino comes on for Hato. Thus far, Chelsea have made three changes in this game and Alonso did confirm before the game that some players should be able to go the full 90 this far into pre-season.

Chelsea hit the post. Quenda receives the ball on the right side of the penalty area and quickly moves the ball onto his right foot. The 19-year-old then smashes a shot towards goal and the ball flies into the outside of the post. Quenda struck that with some venom.

Palmer has a chance to get Chelsea’s fourth from the left side of the box but AC Milan keeper Torriani makes the save down to his left.

AC Milan have offered very little going forward since the break and Sanchez has not been troubled in the Chelsea goal.

AC Milan have a good chance to get a goal back. Musah finds space on the right side of the box and cuts it back towards the penalty spot. He picks out Nkunku but the former Chelsea man wastes the opportunity.

Palestra is found with a cross from the right to the far post. Palestra takes a touch but his shot goes into the side netting.

Ruben Amorim is demanding a free-kick just outside the Chelsea box but the referee does not agree. Replays show that AC Milan probably should have been given the free-kick as it was a foul by Fofana on Ramos. Both players went down but are back to their feet.

Xabi Alonso is going to make his first two changes of the game as Jackson and Quenda replace Welbeck and Neto.

Chelsea have their third and their new set-piece coach Austin MacPhee will be delighted with that one. Lavia plays a flat delivery from a corner out on the left to Caicedo on the edge of the box. Caicedo hits it first time on the volley with the outside of his right foot and picks out the bottom right corner with perfection.

Chelsea go 2-0 up not even a minute into the second half. Neto, on the right side of the box, cuts onto his preferred left foot and crosses to the far post. Pedro gets on the end of it and, despite the Milan keeper getting a touch on the shot, the ball ends up in the far corner.

AC Milan have made a raft of changes at the break, which includes their new record signing Ramos, who has joined from PSG this summer. Former Chelsea man Nkunku is also on. Milan were back out from the dressing rooms a fair bit earlier than Chelsea were. It is rather farcical how long Chelsea took to re-emerge for the second half and they just saunter out as if nothing is up. Why on earth did the officials just allow Chelsea to take over 20 minutes for half-time?

Nearly 25 minutes after the first half concluded, we are finally back under way in Jakarta.

Possession: Chelsea 58%-42% AC MilanShots: 6-4Shots on target: 3-0Corners: 4-2

The first half in Jakarta is brought an end and Chelsea take a 1-0 lead into the break courtesy of Pedro’s goal on the stroke of half-time.

90 seconds into added time at the end of this first half, we have the first goal in Jakarta. Caicedo’s delivery from the right picks out Pedro, who has a free header inside the six-yard box and makes no mistake, picking out the corner. Pedro really should not have been afforded so much space in the six-yard box.

Palestra makes a run in behind the AC Milan defence and is found but De Winter gets back to put it behind for a corner...

Due to the water break, there will be three additional minutes at the end of this first half.

The first booking of the game goes the way of AC Milan as Pavlovic clears out Palestra. A deserved booking.

Neto and Pedro exchange a good one-two down Chelsea’s right to put the former racing down the right wing. Neto then tries to find Welbeck in the centre of the box but it is just behind him.

Then, moments later, Pedro spurns a great chance for Chelsea. Palestra’s cross from the left is just out of Palmer’s reach but falls straight to Pedro, who blazes over from 12 yards out. He was leaning back and should really be hitting the target.

The space opens up for Palmer to take on a shot from range but his effort is blocked by De Winter. Palmer has not managed to have that much of an effect on this game thus far.

Pavlovic drives forward from his defensive position through the Chelsea half. He gets all the way to the Chelsea box before shooting but he looked to lack conviction, firing off target.

We will pause for a drinks break, which unfortunately we became accustomed to during the World Cup. Palmer takes the chance to take a seat on the bench whilst taking on some fluids.

Neto takes a first-time shot from outside the box and looks to curl it into the far corner, forcing Torriani into a decent save diving down to his right.

That is good one-vs-one defending from Achemapong. Estupinan plays the ball into the path of Leao, who drives through the Chelsea half down AC Milan’s left. As Leao approaches the Chelsea box, Leao attempts to push it past Acheampong but the young Chelsea defender times his sliding challenge to perfection and puts it behind for a corner. Sanchez punches it out to the edge of the box, where Comotto takes it on his chest before volleying towards goal. The ball goes behind for another corner, which Chelsea just about scramble away.

Chelsea hit the post. Palestra drives forward for Chelsea down their left before the ball falls to Welbeck on the left side of the box. Welbeck’s effort hits the outside of the post. AC Milan keeper Torriani appeared though to always have it covered.

Chelsea gift the ball away inside their own half and Leao drives forward. The Portuguese forward moves into the Chelsea penalty area before getting his shot away but his effort is blocked.

A big, big chance for Chelsea to take the lead. A long ball is played forward in behind the AC Milan defence and Pedro gets the better of De Winter inside the Milan penalty area. It is then a one-on-one chance with Torriani but Pedro hits it straight at the Milan goalkeeper. Torriani should have come to claim that long ball and then Pedro should probably have buried that opportunity.

Chelsea win their third corner of the game as Palmer’s cross from the right takes a couple of deflections off AC Milan defender. Captain Caicedo has trotted over to take it out on the left. He sends it into a good area but a foul on the AC Milan keeper Torriani is given against Pedro.

Neto clips a free-kick into the AC Milan penalty area, which is chested down by Pedro. The Brazilian holds the ball up well inside the box before winning a corner. Chelsea play it short and Palmer crosses to the back post, where Palestra wins Chelsea another corner, this time out on the left.

Caicedo’s inswinging delivery is headed away at the front post.

Palestra, who has joined Chelsea this summer from Atalanta, is proving his versatility today; he has mostly operated for Chelsea at right-back so far this pre-season but he is starting at left-back in this game.

Camarda is played in behind the Chelsea defence and tries to get the better of Fofana inside the Chelsea penalty area but the ball just runs out of play across the byline before Camarda can square the ball.

We are under way in Jakarta, Indonesia, in Chelsea’s penultimate game over in the Far East. Before the game started, a huge AC Milan tifo was unveiled at one end of the ground.

It is 7pm in Jakarta yet the temperature is still up at 29 degrees with the humidity at nearly 70%. These conditions will be a proper test for both sides.

The teams emerge from the tunnel and we are just moments away from kick-off in Indonesia.

The trophies won by Franco Baresi, who has died at the age of 66, are their own monument to the AC Milan and Italy defender’s greatness. Six times a Serie A champion, five as captain, three European Cup-winning campaigns, 10 other winners’ medals and the distinction of being a member of Italy squads that finished in first, second and third places at World Cup tournaments demonstrate that his career, in a significantly more meritocratic era, stand alongside the giants even if the bias towards attacking virtuosos denied him the Ballon d’Or his talent deserved.

Yet they do not tell us why the grief, so tangible in Milan and beyond today, transcends tribal rivalry. It would be unfair to say that he transformed the art of Italian defending. Gaetano Scirea, the elegant Juventus sweeper who kept the 21-year-old Baresi confined to the bench when Italy won their third World Cup in 1982, had a surplus of natural ability, composure and intelligence. He did not need the raw-elbowed brutality of Claudio Gentile, heir to generations of Italian defenders influenced by the post-war influx of players brought up in the traditions of Argentina and Uruguay.

INS:Marco Palestra ⇠ Atalanta, £42mGeovany Quenda ⇠ Sporting, £42mMorgan Rogers ⇠ Aston Villa, £117mMaxence Lacroix ⇠ Crystal Palace, £51mDanny Welbeck ⇠ Brighton, UndisclosedJordan Henderson ⇠ Brentford, FreeValentin Barco ⇠ Strasbourg, Undisclosed

OUTS:Andrey Santos ⇢ Manchester United, £50mMarc Cucurella ⇢ Real Madrid, £50mTyrique George ⇢ Everton, £24mAlejandro Garnacho ⇢ Aston Villa, Loan

AC Milan: Torriani; Terracciano, De Winter, Pavlovic; Chukwueze, Modric, Comotto, Estupinan; Loftus-Cheek, Leao; Camarda.Substitutes: Ricci, G. Ramos, Diawara, Nkunku, Fofana, Tomori, Athekame, Odogu, Jashari, Bartesaghi, Vladimirov, Pittarella, Gabbia, Saelemakers, Cisse, Musah.

The English forward joined Chelsea from Borussia Dortmund last summer for just under £50m. He struggled to make an impact last season in his first year at Chelsea, failing to register a goal in the Premier League or Champions League but did spend most of the second half of last season on the sidelines due to an injury. Gittens, who is on the bench for Chelsea today, has been speaking this week to CFC+:

“I am feeling, I would say, more confident now, in my body as well. The injury that happened [impacted my first season], but I am feeling better every day. I am trying to improve every day to be the best version of myself. It has been good to be back with the boys. I am really enjoying it right now and it has been really good to be part of this team.”

Have a great day, Jamie. 🥳 pic.twitter.com/QeX83XrXAM

In Chelsea’s defeat to Juventus in midweek, Ukrainian forward Mykhailo Mudryk made his first Chelsea appearance since November 2024 after a long doping ban was resolved. You can read all about that game right here. Mudryk is on the bench for Chelsea today.

July 28- Western Sydney Wanderers 4 Chelsea 6August 1- Chelsea 1 Tottenham 2August 5- Chelsea 0 Juventus 1Today- Chelsea vs AC MilanAugust 9- Johor Darul Ta’z vs ChelseaAugust 15- Chelsea vs Real Sociedad

Current Chelsea defender Tosin Adarabioyo has been catching up with former Chelsea men Ruben Loftus-Cheek, who starts for AC Milan today, and Fikayo Tomori.

The team news is in from Jakarta! 🗞️ pic.twitter.com/BRBjmlgwz8

The atmosphere is building. 🇮🇩📈 pic.twitter.com/fhXfDVAf6s

Chelsea’s pre-season continues out in the Far East as they take on AC Milan in the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta, Indonesia. Both clubs now have new managers, with Xabi Alonso taking over at Chelsea and former Manchester United boss Ruben Amorim now at the helm at AC Milan. These sides met in pre-season last year, with Chelsea winning 4-1 at Stamford Bridge. At that time, now-Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca was in charge whilst Max Allegri, who is now at Napoli, was leading AC Milan. The last time they met competitively was during the 2022/23 Champions League season, with Chelsea winning both games.

Chelsea lost 1-0 to AC Milan’s Serie A rivals Juventus on Wednesday in Hong Kong, in which Danny Welbeck made his first Chelsea appearance after joining from Brighton in the last week.

“We want to have a great team spirit and that is built on a daily basis with a great culture in the building,” Alonso said in his pre-match press conference. “That helps in the moment you have to compete. You feel better having that togetherness, trust, and the bonds between the players are so important to ultimately building a winning mentality, and a team that can compete anywhere. So the football side is so important, but the mental side is as important. And the strength of the team is the most important. We have been able to train and prepare [during pre-season] and I am very happy with the attitude and personality, we know that it is a very important part of this tour.”

It has been another busy week on the transfer front for Chelsea; not only has Welbeck arrived over the last week but so too have Jordan Henderson and Valentin Barco. Alonso’s men have two more games after this against Johor Darul Ta’zim and Real Sociedad before getting their Premier League campaign under way with a derby against Fulham at Craven Cottage.

AC Milan finished fifth in Serie A last season to earn a spot in the Europa League last season. Their big-money acquisition this summer as been Portuguese striker Goncalo Ramos from PSG. They have played two pre-season friendlies so far, which have both ended in draws; 2-2 against Celtic and then 1-1 against city rivals Inter. They kick off their Serie A campaign at Torino on August 23.

#2191. Cruzeiro, può esordire Vitor Hugo: zero presenze, ma già 100 milioni di clausola

Il Cruzeiro in vista della sfida di campionato contro il Palmeiras, in programma nella notte fra mercoledì 18 e giovedì 19 novembre, potrebbe lasciare in prima squadra, probabilmente anche da titolare, il giovane difensore centrale Vitor Hugo, detto Militia, a causa di diversi problemi legati a infortuni (Joao Marcelo), squalifica (Jonathan Jesus) e convocazioni in Nazionale (Fabricio Bruno).

Il classe 2008 è uno dei talenti in rampa di lancio del paese sudamericano e ha un rapporto di sangue con il calcio. La madre, Edilaine Carolina, è stata infatti una calciatrice giocando proprio come centrale di difesa, mentre suo cugino è un certo Eder Militao che veste la maglia del Real Madrid.

Nonostante non abbia mai giocato in prima squadra, ma solo con le selezioni giovanili del Cruzeiro fino all’Under 20, Vitor Hugo ha un prezzo da stella assoluta. Nel contratto da professionista firmato nel 2024, e in scadenza fra due anni, è stata infatti inserita una clausola di rescissione da quasi 100 milioni di euro utile a scongiurare il tentativo di ‘scippo’ da parte di una big europea come spesso avvenuto in passato.

#2190. Fabiani, contratto in scadenza con la Lazio: “Ne parleremo a tempo debito”

Il ds parla del momento della Lazio e del contratto in scadenza: “Ne parleremo a tempo debito. Il calcio non è un semplice contratto”.

Lazio, Fabiani sul futuro: “Il calcio non è un semplice contratto”. E su Formello...

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

La Lazio è capolista della Serie A, ma risultati e classifica non rappresentano l’aspetto che rende maggiormente soddisfatto Angelo Fabiani. Il direttore sportivo biancoceleste guarda soprattutto a ciò che è stato costruito all’interno di Formello.

Intervistato da La Gazzetta dello Sport, Fabiani ha parlato del momento vissuto dalla Lazio, del lavoro portato avanti nel corso della propria carriera e anche del suo contratto in scadenza.

Proprio sul futuro il dirigente ha preferito non anticipare nulla, affidandosi però a una frase significativa: “Ne parleremo a tempo debito. Il calcio non è un semplice contratto”.

Secondo quanto riportato da La Gazzetta dello Sport, Fabiani ha spiegato cosa lo rende maggiormente felice dell’attuale momento della Lazio.

La classifica potrebbe rappresentare la risposta più immediata. Il direttore sportivo, invece, guarda oltre i risultati ottenuti sul terreno di gioco.

“Potrei dire i risultati, la classifica. Ma dove arriveremo chi lo sa. La cosa che invece mi rende felice è l’ambiente che si è creato a Formello. Il calcio è alchimia e qui è stata trovata quella giusta”.

Parole che raccontano il momento vissuto dalla Lazio capolista, ma anche l’importanza che Fabiani attribuisce alla costruzione dell’ambiente intorno alla squadra.

Un lavoro che il dirigente biancoceleste ha già affrontato diverse volte nel corso della propria carriera.

“Ho girato l’Italia in lungo e in largo, sempre per ricostruire. Alla Triestina, al Genoa, con il Messina e poi alla Salernitana, dove è iniziato il sodalizio con Lotito. Ora sto cercando di farlo alla Lazio”.

C’è però anche una questione personale ancora da affrontare. Il contratto di Fabiani è in scadenza.

Interrogato sul tema, il direttore sportivo non ha voluto accelerare i tempi né fornire indicazioni su quello che accadrà.

“Ne parleremo a tempo debito. Il calcio non è un semplice contratto”.

Una risposta breve con cui Fabiani rimanda ogni discorso sul proprio futuro. Il presente, intanto, è quello di una Lazio in testa alla Serie A e di un ambiente a Formello che il direttore sportivo considera il vero motivo di soddisfazione di questo momento.

#2189. 200 defensive contributions: Why Blackburn Rovers had to strike new contract deal with one of Mowbray’s ‘soldiers’

Blackburn Rovers have failed when trying to secure the futures of key players in the past. Among the notable names to leave Ewood Park for nothing in years gone by are Ben Brereton Diaz and Tyrhys Dolan, but work is ongoing to change this pattern.

The latest bit of contract business done by Rovers has seen Irish centre-back Sean McLoughlin tied down for the foreseeable. The length of the new deal is undisclosed, but his initial deal was due to expire at the end of the 2026/27 campaign, although a 12-month extension option was in place.

McLoughlin has been a key influence since joining in 2025, and his importance has grown under Tony Mowbray. The boss has spoken about building teams of “soldiers and artists” in the past, and McLoughlin is one of his most important soldiers.

McLoughlin offered Championship experience and leadership abilities in a side that severely lacked both attributes last season. The Irishman captained Blackburn Rovers on multiple occasions in his debut campaign and missed only two of 46 league matches.

The 29-year-old has remained an ever-present this term, playing all 1,350 Championship minutes to date. He has chipped in with one goal and one assist along the way, but his defensive numbers are where he stands out.

No Championship centre-back has recorded more than McLoughlin’s 200 defensive contributions in 15 games so far this season. Watford captain Mattie Pollock equals that impressive tally, but after them, Birmingham City’s Phil Neumann is the closest on 181.

McLoughlin’s 134 clearances is the most of all Championship centre-backs, constantly meeting crosses and attacking deliveries to hoof the danger as far from Balazs Toth‘s goal as possible. His 65 duels won, 40 of them in the air, and 22 blocked shots (top 3%) encapsulate the soldier spirit Mowbray wants from his Rovers defenders.

His wider game deserves praise as well though, showing his passing range with 662 successful passes, 51 accurate long balls and 133 line-breaking passes. McLoughlin reads the game well too, with 31 interceptions ranking him in the top 4% in his position (all stats via FotMob).

The extension option meant McLoughlin’s contract wasn’t a pressing matter. However, the new deal shows proactivity on this front from Blackburn Rovers.

Not only this, but it shows that the former Hull City man is happy at Ewood Park and committed to the task at hand under Mowbray. The hope will be that other valuable players can follow suit and pledge their futures to Rovers.

Todd Cantwell has starred under Mowbray and his deal expires next summer. The same goes for Toth, but the Hungarian goalkeeper continues to rebuff new offers and seems likely to depart in 2027.

The McLoughlin news is positive though, and it will be hoped he can continue to impress in blue and white halves.

#2187. Lazio-Inter, Supercoppa a San Siro: sei cambi possibili nei supplementari

Il regolamento consente fino a cinque sostituzioni nei tempi regolamentari; la sfida è fissata al 22 dicembre alle 21:00.

Inter e Lazio si affronteranno martedì 22 dicembre 2026 alle 21:00 a San Siro per la Supercoppa italiana. La trentanovesima edizione, denominata ufficialmente EA SPORTS FC Supercup, si giocherà in gara unica. La Lega Calcio Serie A ha ufficializzato data, orario, sede e regolamento della partita con un comunicato.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

La sfida al Meazza prevede due tempi supplementari da 15 minuti ciascuno se il risultato sarà in parità dopo i 90 minuti regolamentari. Se la parità dovesse persistere, la Supercoppa verrà assegnata ai calci di rigore.

Per la loro esecuzione si applicheranno le modalità indicate nel «Regolamento del Giuoco del Calcio», al paragrafo «Procedure per determinare la squadra vincente di una gara». Inter-Lazio sarà trasmessa in diretta sulle reti Mediaset.

Ciascuna squadra potrà effettuare fino a cinque sostituzioni, utilizzando non più di tre interruzioni di gioco, oltre all’intervallo tra i due tempi. Se si andrà ai supplementari, sarà disponibile una quarta interruzione. Restano inoltre utilizzabili le pause tra la fine dei tempi regolamentari e l’inizio del primo supplementare, e tra il primo e il secondo supplementare.

Solo in caso di tempi supplementari sarà consentito un ulteriore cambio: il limite delle sostituzioni salirà così a sei per squadra.

Il comunicato della Lega disciplina anche le squalifiche di calciatori e tecnici. Chi è in diffida e riceve un’ammonizione nella giornata di campionato precedente la Supercoppa sconterà la squalifica nella successiva gara di campionato. La stessa collocazione è prevista per la squalifica, o per la parte residua della sanzione, di chi viene espulso nella giornata precedente la Supercoppa o ha già una sanzione da scontare; se necessario, il provvedimento riguarderà più gare di campionato.

Anche un calciatore o tecnico già in diffida che venga ammonito durante la Supercoppa sconterà la squalifica nella successiva partita di campionato. Per un’espulsione nella gara del 22 dicembre, la squalifica sarà invece scontata nella gara o nelle gare di campionato successive.

#2186. EFL expert Jobi McAnuff backs ‘fantastic’ Middlesbrough as Championship promotion favourites

Middlesbrough are winless in their last two games against Wrexham and Watford. They drew 0-0 with the latter last time out at Vicarage Road before the international break.

Boro are sat joint-top of the Championship table after 15 fixtures along with Birmingham City and Stoke City. They are behind the Blues on goal difference.

McAnuff, who played for the likes of Cardiff City, Watford and Reading, has delivered his verdict on Kim Hellberg‘s side on BBC’s 72+ Podcast: “Middlesbrough are a fantastic team. I love what Kim Hellberg has done. It’s amazing isn’t it, for such a good team, so well functioning around the striker (Will Lankshear), you take him out and he’s been phenomenal this season, what an impact that can have.

“That was a little bit the issue last season, not having that real killer at the top end of the pitch to take those half chances, getting in that position. They’ve missed him the last couple (of games). I still have them for sure as my favourites. I think anyone who is above them this year will be getting automatically promoted.”

Middlesbrough sold key man Hayden Hackney to Everton in the summer. Boro also got money from a sell-on clause they had on Morgan Rogers from Aston Villa to Chelsea.

They reinvested heavily into their playing squad following their play-off final defeat to Hull City at Wembley back in May. The likes of Will Lankshear, Ashley Phillips and Radek Vitek came through the entrance door at the Riverside Stadium.

Lankshear, 21, has been prolific under the guidance of Hellberg and has scored 15 league goals already. However, he has missed the last two outings against Wrexham and Watford due to injury and his presence has been missed.

The ex-Tottenham Hotspur will be hoping to return after the international break against Bristol City at home. His team haven’t managed to score without him which is a big worry.

Middlesbrough can’t just rely solely on Lankshear. They need others like David Strelec and Kyle Joseph to step up.

The latter was snapped up from Hull City in early July. He hasn’t managed to score yet in the league and has found it hard to find his shooting boots.

Boro have been strong overall this term and will fancy their chances of finishing in the top two. Hellberg is an impressive young manager and as McAnuff alluded to, his team are well drilled and tough to play against.

They have some solid players like Aidan Morris, Amario Cozier-Duberry and Riley McGree and on their day, they are a match for anyone in the second tier. Hellberg’s men will be eager to return to winning ways against Bristol City next up and their upcoming opponents have been struggling for form of late.

Middlesbrough will get the chance to freshen up their squad in January with some new faces. They will also have the opportunity to let some players leave if needed.

#2185. Napoli su Varela, ma il Monza lo valuta 40 milioni: ci sono anche altre squadre

William Scuotto per IlNapolista ha raccolto delle informazioni sulla trattativa tra il Napoli e Varela:

“Gustavo Varela al Napoli al momento è poco più di una speranza. Si è aperta un’asta attorno al centravanti che il Monza ha portato in Brianza per soli 2,5 milioni. Adesso il giovane portoghese (ha 21 anni) ne vale più di 40. È la cifra raccolta dal Napolista che ha parlato con fonti accreditate. Il lusitano è stato un ottimo investimento da parte della società lombarda. Varela ha segnato 9 gol in 9 partite ed è in testa alla classifica marcatori. Da solo.

È fisiologico che il Monza voglia monetizzare. Ci sono tanti club interessati al calciatore. C’è anche il Napoli ma la cifra è quella. E al momento non è ancora chiaro se il Monza voglia la somma cash o se sia disposto ad altre modalità di pagamento.

Chiaramente Su Varela ci sono anche club stranieri, c’è anche il Benfica ma la somma è alta. In un calcio povero di centravanti che segnano, averne uno è un tesori. Sia per la squadra sia per il mercato.

Il Monza deciderà i tempi e le modalità. Fino a gennaio ci sono ancora altre partite: se Varela dovesse proseguire a questo ritmo, la quotazione potrebbe persino salire.”.

#2184. Man Utd impress in draw against PSG but injury worries mount

Michael Carrick said he had to be careful with Mason Mount after the England midfielder handed Manchester United an injury scare in their friendly draw with Paris St Germain.

Mount has had a torrid time with injuries since signing from Chelsea in a £55m-deal three years ago, starting only 25 Premier League games for United in that time.

The 27-year-old has been successfully deployed by Carrick in a central midfield role during pre-season, leading to speculation that United may not make another expected signing in that department.

But Mount played only 18 minutes of Saturday’s 1-1 draw against the European champions in Gothenburg before being replaced by Scotland international Tyler Fletcher.

“He [Mount] got kicked. We just wanted to be careful and look after him,” Carrick, the United head coach, told reporters in Sweden.

“We’ve been lucky with injuries so far, so we wanted to be careful.”

Post-match video footage showed Mount walking freely on to the United bus without the aid of a protective boot or knee support.

Michael Carrick told VG Mason Mount was taken off as a precaution. Looked OK leaving stadium. pic.twitter.com/Uo0fBtgpAl

United went behind within two minutes at the Ullevi Stadium when Liverpool target Ibrahim Mbaye punished slack marking to put PSG ahead.

Bryan Mbeumo fired United level after 32 minutes following good work from Amad Diallo, the Cameroon forward’s third goal in two games after his match-winning double against Atletico Madrid.

United meet Leeds in a Dublin friendly on Wednesday before coming up against AC Milan and their former manager Ruben Amorim next Saturday.

United open their Premier League campaign at Hull on August 22.

“It was good game. PSG is good so we had to keep building fitness. I am happy to have other [players] back and we have to keep going.”

“It’s good for me. I enjoyed it. We need to build fitness, we have a big season ahead.”

“It’s a good game PSG are tough to beat and we got a draw and now think about the next game [against Leeds in Dublin].”

“We have two more games against Leeds a and Milan. We need to have big season and hope to win a trophy.”

All over in Gothenburg and it’s been a good match for Michael Carrick’s team. They looked sharper and quicker than their win over Atletico Madrid last week (what the manager wanted) and things are moving in the right direction. Two things to worry about, however, were the early exits of Mason Mount and Tom Heaton with injuries. They’ll especially hope the Mount knock isn’t anything mid or long term.

Nearly done and it’s been a good run out for United. They’ve looked the better, sharper side and, if anything, deserve to win. In mitigation, this is United fourth pre-season game to PSG’s second...

Fernandes has one thing on his mind when he gets the ball 25 yards out in the centre of the park - a shot. He unleashes the attempt, destined for the bottom-left corner, forcing Longoni, the sub goalkeeper, into a good save.

Two chances for United in quick succession. A lovely ball from the middle of the park by Zirkzee finds Dalot on the right. He chips the ball to the back post where one of the Fletchers (sorry, I am not sure which) heads for goal. His attempt is blocked and the ball, ultimately, falls at the feet of Lacey whose shot is blazed high over the bar.

There have been plenty of good things for Carrick to take from this match. The passing, while not of the standard of a cut-and-thrust Premier League match, has been good for the time of year, and there have been enough flashes of brilliance/class/invention etc to suggest that pre-season is moving in the right direction.

Lovely bit of play by United. A great pass with the outside of the boot from the inside-left channel by Tielemans finds Fernandes who plays a sidefooted shot that goes just wide.

Tielemans’s first bit of brilliance from the Belgian there.

Both sides losing possession a fair bit at the moment. Strong pre-season vibes right now.

Maguire has had a good game. He’s played a number of long passes from the back and looked assured. This time he’s up in the PSG half and decides to have a pop - his shot testing Safanov, who saves well.

Had there been VAR Safanov might have had something to answer for...he may have beaten Zirkzee to the ball but he flew in the air and jurt the United man in the process.

Anwway, there’s no VAR (hurrah, for those of you who consider it a modern-day evil) and it doesn’t matter.

Chance for United to go ahead and it comes from two things. (i) A long, hopeful ball from Fernandes that looks for Zirkzee (ii) Safanov rushing off his line and into no-man’s land. The ball comes loose and Jack Fletcher, instead of having a go at goal, with the keeper on the ground and out of the game, passes to Lacey whose shot is wide.

Tyler Fletcher loses the ball near the United half and it, ultimately, results in a PSG corner. From the set piece United defend well and snuff out all hint of danger.

PSG seeing more of the ball at the moment. They work the ball to the right and Amass brings down Mbaye.

From the resulting free-kick, in the final third, the French side whip in the ball but Mee is up ot the challenge and come to collect well.

Santos, Mbeumo, Shaw, Amad, Lacey are off

Fernandes, Jack Feltcher, Zirkzee and Amass are on.

A raft of changes for PSG sees Marquinhos and João Neves, among others, come on. More like it, in terms of first-team ‘names’, on the pitch for the European Cup champions.

United on top in this half, as they were in the first.

The paces quickens and the game is much better for it. Mbuemo drives toward the PSG box, he cuts inside from the right before unleashing a shot that is bound for the back of the net before a fine one-handed save by Safanov. Credit, too, for Maguire whose long ball from the back found Mbuemo brilliantly. Promising...

Lacey tries to play in Dorgu on the left but he’s asking too much of his team-mate. Wonder when the expected raft of changes will take place?

Slow start to the second half. This is very much pre-season-friendly pace.

Having seen Mount limp off in the first half, there’s more worry at the start of the second and Heaton is force off with what looks like a hamstrung injury. He dashed off his line to clear a ball and in doing so has tweaked something. Mee replaces him.

Back under way Gothenburg - there have been a number of changes and will bring them to you once I’ve worked out who has come on and who they’ve replaced.

A world record that still stands...(this was back in 1995).

And that is it for the first 45 minutes. PSG took the early lead, but from that moment on United have been the better side and deservedly are level through Mbueno’s goal.

There will be one minute of added time at the end of what has been a good first half for Man Utd.

Amad has a go from outside the box forcing the save from Safanov. He’s such a live wire and one of the best in his position in the top flight. Him or Antony? No contest, strange it took United a while to work that one out.

Yet more good work from the underrated Amad. He again closes down well on the right before winning back possession and cutting the ball back for Lacey. To think he was starring for Sunderland in the Championship while Antony was starting for United...

United have been the better side since conceding earlier and, as if to illustrate my point, as I typed that an Mbuemo free-kick is well saved by Safanov. That was heading for the top-right bin.

Great work on the left by Dorgu and Shaw ends with the latter chipping the ball to the back post where Amad is lurking with intent. The Ivorian looks to head the ball home, but before he can get anything on it it looks as though he’s pushed in the back. United players are sure it’s a penalty but, more importantly, the referee doesn’t.

Amad does brilliantly, winning the ball off Koukaba in the final third, from there he scampers toward the box before playing in Mbuemo who takes one touch before firing in a shot into the bottom right corner of the net.

Free-kick for PSG on the right, near the final third. The ball comes in and it’s straight into the arms of Heaton in the United goal.

Kvaratskhelia, not seen much of him so far, runs into the box, but Amad does well to usher him back out.

The match is pedestrian at the moment, but as I type that, Dorgu, yep, him again, drives down the left and puts in a good cross that is well intercepted by Safanov in the PSG goal.

United continue to see more of the ball, Dorgu’s seeing more of it than most. But, no chances really fashioned, still, plenty of time to go.

Worry for United having to sub off Mount. It looks as though he took a knock to a foot and Carrick and co will hope it’s not a long-term injury. Mount, who’s had a good pre-season, has been replaced by Fletcher, son of Darren.

Foul on Mazraoui results in two things. The Mount has to come off, and, United have a free-kick on the edge of the PSG area.

From the set-piece Mbuemo has a go and it’s a regulation save from Safonov in the PSG goal.

Heaven loses possession in the middle of the park and from there it’s like the parting of the Red Sea as PSG have a three-on-one. Mbaye gets the shot in on goal but Andrey Santos covers back brilliantly and does enough to get something on the ball. He’s started both this match and pre-season well.

United are looking half decent on the ball. They’re passing it well and not afraid to switch things around.

A lovely long ball from Maguire finds Dorgo whose lovely first touch takes him into the box before a cut back is intercepted by a PSG man. Promising signs though for Carrick’s men.

United seeing more of the ball at the moment. They’re being patient but cannot fashion an opening and the ball is worked all the way back to Heaton in goal.

Needless to say this is being played at a slowish pace...no blood-and-guts challenges being put in.

Good work down the right sees Amad plays in Shay Lacey who crosses into the box. The ball find shte head of Mbuemo and the ball sails over the bar. Better from United.

United started slowly against Atletico and they’ve done the same here.

Bright start to say the least from the French side. They work the ball left and it’s an easy cross from Dro Fernandez for Mbaye to tap home for the very early lead.

They’re under way in Sweden. United are in their new vibrant red kit and PSG in their blue, red and white kit. Big fan of the French side’s kit, it harks back to the kit they had in the 1990s when the likes of George Weah and David Ginola were entertaining in the capital of France.

Man Utd: Heaton, Mazraoui, Maguire, Heaven, Shaw, Mount, Santos, Dorgu, Lacey, Amad, Mbeumo; Subs: Heath, Mee, Amass, Armer, Dalot, Yoro, Fernandes, J. Fletcher, T. Fletcher, Tielemans, Zirkzee

Paris St-Germain: Safonov, Pacho, Zabarnyi, Koukaba, Boly, Beraldo, Dro, Mayulu, Kvaratskhelia, Ayari, Mbaye; Subs: Marquinhos, Mendes, Lucea, Vitinha, Neves, El Nay, Idder, Drame, Bourdin, Ndjantou, Meite, Longoni, Chevalier

And here’s a famous match that took place there, giving a certain Sir Alex Ferguson his first European trophy.

“Get a bit sharper, get better on the ball, go up a notch.”

“It’s not about today it’s about preparing. Some players have played 90 minutes, some have played three games, some have just come back. So it’s about keeping working on things we’ve been working on.”

“They’re similar to us, but have fewer senior players available . They’ve had a great time and great squad so whoever on the pitch it will be a test.”

A hugely talented player for a number of clubs, including United, who ever really lived up to his early promise.

Good to have you back, lads 🇵🇹 pic.twitter.com/3EgkXLqcQm

📃 Le onze de départ pour cette rencontre de préparation face à Manchester United. #PSGMUN pic.twitter.com/LodcDM1Yrm

I expect they’ll make an appearence at some point.

Ready to face PSG in our latest pre-season test ✊

Manchester United continue their Sweden sojourn with match against Paris St-Germain in Gothenburg.

Clearly a clash against the back-to-back Champions League winners is a step up from their previous two pre-season friendlies (victories against Rosenborg and Atletico Madrid), but at the same time this is more a chance for players to get miles in the legs and see how new signings and possibly some young guns fit in.

One of those new signings is Youri Tielemans, and the Belgian international is in line to make his debut after his move from Aston Villa. Other team news is that Bruno Fernandes is back and ready to captain the team.

Michael Carrick has also been boosted by the returns of Matheus Cunha, Diogo Dalot and Noussair Mazraoui after their post-World Cup breaks.

Cunha, however, will not play a part in today’s match because of a “minor illness” according to the MUTV website. He is expected to link up with the squad in Ireland, where they face Leeds United at Croke Park, after the match.

This will be Man Utd’s first outing since the 2-1 win over Atletico, a performance and result that pleased Carrick.

“I enjoyed it, I thought there was a lot of good in things that we are looking to improve on,” the United manager said. “Building on what we did for the last seven months, I think there is a lot of good signs for us, it’s never going to be the exact stage we want to be at. But I thought there was really a lot of positives to take out of the game, individual, collectively as a team, senior players looking strong and fit, and the younger players doing really well.

“The spirit and the camaraderie is so important for the team, it’s great to see the boys getting on so naturally and enjoying each other’s company. Collectively we looked strong as a team, which is always the most important thing, and individual performances seeing the young players come on to have an impact.”

Kick-off is set for 4pm so stay here for the build up, team news and action.

#2183. Gallo confermato a Vicenza, intanto che Iemmello rinnova a Catanzaro. SudTirol, vicino Cragno

Un'altra settimana di sosta, dopo quella lunghissima tra settembre e ottobre, per la Serie B, che si ferma per le Nazionali. Non si ferma però il mercato, con le varie compagini che piano piano si stanno ritrovando per il via della preparazione.

A proposito di ritrovi, un po' a sorpresa, a dirigere gli allenamenti del Vicenza - rigorosamente a porte chiuse - si è visto Fabio Gallo, che sembrava prossimo all'esonero dopo ko di domenica scorsa contro la Cremonese, che ha sbancato il 'Menti' sul punteggio di 1-4. Dopo un lungo confronto tra società e dirigenza, si è optato per non esonerare il trainer, che dalla sua aveva anche la piazza, ma la fiducia è solo a tempo: se nelle prossime tre sfide non ci sarà l'inversione di rotta, si consumerà probabilmente l'addio.

Novità, ci potrebbero poi essere in casa SudTirol, con Alessio Cragno che si sta allenando con i biancorossi dopo essersi ristabilito dall'infortunio al tendine d'Achille della gamba sinistra rimediato a marzo; dopo un mese che è servito a valutare le sue condizioni, c'è stata somma soddisfazione del club, che sarebbe pronto a tesserarlo. Di prolungamenti, invece, si parla in casa Catanzaro. Capitan Pietro Iemmello continuerà a vestire la maglia giallorossa fino al 30 giugno 2028; il rinnovo è stato già firmato, ma per il momento non è previsto alcun annuncio ufficiale.

#2182. Lazio, Fabiani: “A gennaio non parte nessuno”. Poi sorprende su Floriani

Il ds blinda la rosa per gennaio e, tra i protagonisti della Lazio, indica Floriani: “Ci credevamo, ora sta mostrando chi è”.

Lazio, Fabiani: “A gennaio non parte nessuno”. Poi sorprende su Floriani

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Nessuno lascerà la Lazio durante il mercato invernale. A garantirlo è il direttore sportivo biancoceleste Angelo Fabiani, che chiude così la porta a possibili partenze a gennaio nonostante la crescita del valore della rosa.

Il lavoro sul mercato e quello svolto da Gattuso hanno infatti aumentato in maniera esponenziale il valore dei giocatori della Lazio capolista della Serie A. Una situazione che potrebbe inevitabilmente attirare l’attenzione di altri club.

Fabiani, però, non sembra avere alcun dubbio sulle intenzioni della società. E quando gli viene chiesto di scegliere, tra Frattesi, Tavares, Taylor, Belahyane, Noslin e Isaksen, il colpo del quale va maggiormente fiero, il ds sorprende indicando un altro nome: Floriani.

Secondo quanto riportato da La Gazzetta dello Sport, il direttore sportivo della Lazio ha affrontato entrambi gli argomenti nel corso dell’intervista concessa al quotidiano.

La crescita della rosa biancoceleste potrebbe aumentare inevitabilmente l’interesse nei confronti dei calciatori della Lazio. Fabiani riconosce quanto sia aumentato il loro valore, ma esclude possibili “scippi” durante la prossima finestra di mercato.

“Che adesso i giocatori valgano molti di più è un dato di fatto. Ma nel mercato invernale non andrà via nessuno, questo lo posso garantire”.

Parole nette da parte del direttore sportivo. La Lazio, dunque, secondo quanto garantito da Fabiani, non perderà nessuno dei suoi giocatori durante il mercato di gennaio.

A Fabiani vengono poi sottoposti diversi nomi: Frattesi, Tavares, Taylor, Belahyane, Noslin e Isaksen. La domanda è semplice: di quale colpo va più fiero?

Il direttore sportivo parte però da un’esperienza precedente alla Lazio: “Di Napoli, che presi al Messina. Voleva smettere, è diventato Re Artù”.

Quando il discorso si sposta specificamente sulla Lazio, la scelta ricade invece su Floriani.

“Come Lazio dico Floriani. Non è un acquisto, ma un ragazzo che abbiamo cresciuto, mandato a giocare con il premio di valorizzazione perché ci credevamo e ora sta mostrando chi è”.

Una risposta significativa, soprattutto considerando i nomi proposti nella domanda. Fabiani non sceglie uno degli acquisti indicati, ma punta su un giocatore cresciuto dalla Lazio e nel quale, come sottolineato dallo stesso direttore sportivo, il club aveva deciso di credere.

#2181. Zero goals in seven games: Ex-Sheffield Wednesday man struggles for form after stern ‘good riddance’ exit message

Sheffield Wednesday rebuilt their squad in the summer, with a brand-new group of players put together after multiple departures. Among those to move on was striker Ike Ugbo, who joined Cypriot side Apollon Limassol on an initial season-long loan after two goals in 62 games as a permanent SWFC player.

Ugbo’s move was viewed as a much-needed one for all parties, and former administrator Kris Wigfield didn’t hesitate to make his feelings known upon the deal. He wrote in a since-deleted X post: “When even in the bleakest of financial circumstances, a high wage earner shows such entitlement for the money they receive and such contempt for the supporters that were literally paying his wages – you have no chance. Good riddance.”

Ugbo defended himself before turning his attention to the next chapter in his career. A move to Cyprus marked a chance for the 28-year-old to rediscover his past best, but he has struggled to hit the ground running.

Ugbo scored only twice in two seasons after earning a permanent move to Sheffield Wednesday. His initial loan under Danny Rohl was a major success as his seven goals helped inspire the Owls to Championship survival.

Unfortunately, such success has proven tough to emulate, and that has been the case with Apollon Limassol too. Ugbo has made seven appearances – all from the bench – and failed to find the back of the net.

He played in their UEFA Conference League third-round qualifier and his other six outings have come in the league. Apollon Limassol were unbeaten in the first eight matches before a 1-0 loss to Olympiakos Nicosia last weekend.

Ex-SWFC man Ugbo’s battle to break into the starting XI has been made tougher by the form of fellow summer signing Alen Ozbolt, who has seven goals in 11 games from striker. Wingers Brandon Thomas (five goals, three assists) and Garry Rodrigues (four goals, five assists) have impressed too.

Ugbo is still searching for form in Cyprus, and Sheffield Wednesday are hoping a new talisman emerges too.

Jamal Lowe has seven goals in 15 games having made a strong start to the season, but form has waned in recent weeks and he served a three-match suspension for a red card against Notts County on October 20th.

Davis Keillor-Dunn has found more minutes and now has five goals in 13 appearances. Among those hoping to come up with more consistent goalscoring returns for new SWFC boss Dave Challinor are Mason Burstow, Ali Al-Hamadi and Harry Gray.

The unlocking of a truly prolific goalscorer will be key if the Owls are to cement themselves as strong promotion candidates in League One.

#2180. Si infiamma il mercato degli allenatori: Pochettino verso lo United. Nuovo rinnovo per Simeone

Il mercato degli allenatori non si ferma mai e nei prossimi giorni potrebbe regalare nuove sorprese con il Manchester United che ha deciso di cambiare guida tecnica comunicando a Michael Carrick l'esonero, anche se manca ancora l'ufficialità, e puntando tutto su quel Mauricio Pochettino che attualmente guida gli Stati Uniti ed è impegnato a preparare la doppia sfida contro Haiti in Nations League.

Mauricio Pochettino ha dato il proprio assenso al Manchester United ed è pronto a tornare in Premier League. Secondo le ultime indiscrezioni raccolte dalla nostra redazione, l'ex allenatore di Tottenham e Chelsea ha già comunicato alla federazione statunitense la volontà di lasciare l'incarico di commissario tecnico degli USA per raccogliere la sfida di Old Trafford. Allo stesso modo la proprietà del club inglese ha comunicato a Carrick la decisione e ora è al lavoro per trovare l'accordo con la US Soccer a cui l'argentino è legato fino al 2030. Probabilmente il club inglese pagherà un indennizzo (si parla di circa 10 milioni di euro) per liberarlo e averlo a disposizione dopo il doppio impegno di questa pausa.

Il nome in cima alla lista della US Soccer per sostituire Pochettino alla guida della Nazionale a stelle e strisce sarebbe quello di Pep Guardiola, svincolato dopo l’addio al Manchester City in estate e che al momento non sembra però intenzionato a ripartire da una panchina tanto da aver rifiutato la proposta dell’Italia che ha poi virato sul ritorno di Roberto Mancini in panchina. Il catalano piace per le sue qualità di allenatore e l’esperienza internazionale accumulata allenando in tre nazioni diverse (Spagna, Germania e Inghilterra).

Se a Manchester si cambia nuovamente a Madrid, sponda Atletico, invece si va ancora avanti con quel Diego Simeone che siede sulla panchina dal 2011. Il club spagnolo è infatti pronto a rinnovare il suo contratto in scadenza a fine stagione considerandolo una priorità per progettare il futuro. Il prossimo passaggio chiave è previsto nel mese di dicembre, quando club e allenatore si incontreranno per fare il punto della situazione e valutare i progressi della trattativa. Il clima è positivo e la volontà comune è quella di proseguire insieme, tanto che l'ipotesi di un prolungamento fino al 2029 prende sempre più quota.

#2178. Lazio, Piazza della Libertà cambia volto: conclusa la grande riqualificazione

Conclusa la riqualificazione del giardino: nuovi viali, pavimentazione e un'area sportiva nel luogo dove nacque la Lazio.

Lazio, rinasce Piazza della Libertà: nuovo volto per il luogo dove tutto ebbe inizio

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Piazza della Libertà cambia volto e torna a valorizzare uno dei luoghi più significativi della storia della Lazio. Sono terminati gli interventi di riqualificazione e abbellimento del giardino della piazza nella quale, nel 1900, nacque la Società Podistica Lazio.

Oggi, mercoledì 11 novembre, alle ore 13, si è svolto l'incontro tra il Primo Municipio di Roma Capitale e la Fondazione S.S. Lazio 1900 ETS per presentare i lavori conclusi. Nuovi viali, pavimentazione e un'area attrezzata per lo sport restituiscono un volto rinnovato a uno dei salotti più nobili della Città Eterna.

Una giornata dal significato ancora più profondo per il mondo biancoceleste. Proprio l'11 novembre 2007 moriva Gabriele Sandri, tifoso laziale. Per mantenerne vivo il ricordo, la famiglia ha fortemente voluto la nascita della Fondazione Gabriele Sandri, realtà che proprio da Piazza della Libertà ha dato vita a numerose iniziative sociali e benefiche nel nome di Gabriele.

Secondo quanto riportato dalla Fondazione S.S. Lazio 1900 ETS, la conclusione degli interventi rappresenta un nuovo passo nel percorso di valorizzazione di un luogo indissolubilmente legato alla storia biancoceleste.

È proprio da Piazza della Libertà che ebbe inizio un'avventura lunga ormai oltre 126 anni. Una storia che nel tempo ha attraversato campi di gioco, piscine, fiumi e laghi, parquet dei palazzetti, piste degli stadi, cieli e montagne. Ovunque fosse possibile praticare sport, lì è arrivata la Lazio.

I lavori sono stati realizzati attraverso risorse PNRR, nell'ambito del progetto Caput Mundi, gestito dal Ministero del Turismo e la cui attuazione è stata affidata alla Struttura commissariale per il Giubileo 2025. Gli interventi hanno interessato diverse zone del giardino con l'obiettivo di aumentarne fruibilità, accessibilità e qualità urbana.

Sono stati costruiti tre nuovi viali. Il primo collega via Cesi con l'interno del giardino. Il secondo attraversa la zona centrale dell'area in direzione del viale interno già esistente, mentre il terzo conduce verso la Torretta della Fondazione S.S. Lazio 1900 ETS.

È stata inoltre realizzata la pavimentazione dello spazio che circonda la Torretta lungo i tre lati rivolti verso il giardino. Nell'area centrale sono state posizionate anche due lastre di travertino, utilizzate per la copertura e il livellamento dello spazio.

Particolare attenzione è stata riservata allo sport. Sul lato del giardino rivolto verso Ponte Regina Margherita è nata una nuova area attrezzata. Sono state installate una struttura calistenica con barre per le trazioni e panca, collocata su una pavimentazione antitrauma, oltre a una struttura bikefit.

All'incontro hanno preso parte l'assessore municipale Stefano Marin e i rappresentanti della Fondazione S.S. Lazio 1900 ETS.

Grande soddisfazione è stata espressa da Marco Chiarion Casoni, presidente della Fondazione S.S. Lazio 1900 ETS.

«Siamo orgogliosi e felici che Piazza della Libertà, sede della nascita e parte fondamentale della storia della nostra Società, sia stata interessata da un intervento così importante – dichiara Casoni –. La riqualificazione, il rinnovamento degli spazi e la presenza di nuove attrezzature sportive restituiscono alla piazza una maggiore qualità e una nuova capacità di essere vissuta dalla cittadinanza».

Il percorso, tuttavia, non si fermerà con la conclusione di questi lavori.

«Ma il progetto di valorizzazione non finisce qui – aggiunge Casoni –. Insieme al Primo Municipio stiamo lavorando per continuare ad abbellire e valorizzare Piazza della Libertà. Per noi è particolarmente significativo poter contribuire alla cura di un luogo nel quale, 126 anni fa, è iniziata la storia della Lazio. Ringraziamo le istituzioni e l'architetto Romolo Crescenzi per il lavoro svolto e per aver reso possibile questa evoluzione».

Soddisfazione anche da parte del Municipio Roma I Centro. L'assessore Stefano Marin ha sottolineato il valore dell'intervento per la città e per il territorio.

«Ringrazio la Fondazione S.S. Lazio 1900 ETS per la collaborazione e tutti coloro che hanno contribuito alla realizzazione di questi interventi. Piazza della Libertà è un luogo importante per la storia sportiva e per la vita del nostro territorio. Siamo felici di restituire ai cittadini uno spazio più bello, accessibile e vivibile», dichiara Marin.

Una Piazza della Libertà rinnovata, dunque, ma sempre profondamente legata alle proprie radici. Proprio lì dove, 126 anni fa, iniziò la storia della Lazio.

#2177. ‘We are concerned’: Aribim Pepple among triple Plymouth Argyle injury worries ahead of Sheffield Wednesday tie

Plymouth Argyle sit 5th in the League One table coming into this weekend’s clash with Sheffield Wednesday. It marks an important game for PAFC given their opponents are also in the promotion conversation, but Tom Cleverley and co have a new trio of injuries to deal with.

Speaking to The Herald, the Pilgrims boss revealed muscle injuries are casting doubt over the availability of Aribim Pepple, Alex Mitchell and Michael Baidoo. Cleverley said: “We are concerned with a few of them. We have had a good result tonight and whatever team we take to Sheffield on Saturday we will have full confidence that it can go and do a job and get a win.”

Cleverley later described Pepple and Mitchell specifically as “major doubts”. If they are indeed sidelined, they will join Julio Pleguezuelo as a recent injury blow having damaged his calf in training last week.

Centre-back Mitchell is a powerful figure in defence and a mainstay for Cleverley. He will be a miss for Plymouth Argyle, but there is the depth to deal with his absence with Mathias Ross and Alex Hartridge both available.

Baidoo meanwhile has been building towards his comeback, so a setback comes as a blow. When fully fit, there is intrigue over whether he can grow into an influential player for Cleverley after a tough time at Home Park since joining in January 2025.

Of the three though, Pepple is the most influential. The Canadian striker is PAFC’s leading goalscorer and main attacking threat, offering excellent finishing and link-up ability as a powerful figure at the top of the pitch.

Losing his clinical finishing and ability to lead the line will be a big blow against Sheffield Wednesday. It will be hoped that Pepple is not facing a long spell out, as it will leave a sizeable gap in the frontline to fill.

Cleverley will be forced into changes from his usual lineup if Pepple and Mitchell are ruled out. He has the depth to deal with the absences, although the Plymouth Argyle side is undoubtedly weaker without them.

In defence, the earlier mentioned Alex Hartridge or Mathias Ross could come into the team. Wes Harding has mainly been used at full-time this term but the vice captain can be used centrally if Cleverley wishes.

At striker, it depends on the setup Cleverley opts for. Will Evans seems bound to start either way, but if he wants to partner him with another forward in a 4-4-2, Owen Oseni may be introduced after his recent comeback from injury.

Oliver Irow has been played up front before too, so the PAFC boss has decisions to make.
